# dependencytrack_service_account (Resource)

Manages a Dependency-Track service account: a non-human identity for automation such as CI pipelines. A service account authenticates with its own expiring API keys (see `dependencytrack_service_account_api_key`) or through workload identity federation. Its username is its name with the reserved `svc:` prefix; use that username with `dependencytrack_managed_user_permissions` and `dependencytrack_user_team_membership` to grant permissions and team memberships. Requires Dependency-Track 5.2 or newer and the `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A service account for a CI pipeline (Dependency-Track 5.2+)
resource "dependencytrack_service_account" "ci" {
  name  = "ci-pipeline"
  email = "platform-team@example.com"
}

# Grant permissions directly, keyed by the account's svc: username
resource "dependencytrack_managed_user_permissions" "ci" {
  user        = dependencytrack_service_account.ci.username
  permissions = ["BOM_UPLOAD", "VIEW_PORTFOLIO"]
}

# Or through a team
resource "dependencytrack_team" "automation" {
  name = "CI Automation"
}

resource "dependencytrack_user_team_membership" "ci" {
  username = dependencytrack_service_account.ci.username
  team     = dependencytrack_team.automation.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service account, without the `svc:` prefix (max 59 characters). Must start with a letter or digit, followed by letters, digits, or `+=,.:@_-`

### Optional

- `email` (String) The email address of the service account (max 255 characters)
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether the service account is suspended. A suspended account cannot authenticate. Default: `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the service account (same as `name`)
- `username` (String) The full username of the service account: its name with the `svc:` prefix

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Service accounts can be imported using their name (without the svc: prefix).
terraform import dependencytrack_service_account.example ci-pipeline
```
